segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I just wanted to confirm the final seat count and the go-live window so I can get the order form cleaned up today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 48 users for launch, with 6 of those being admin seats. We may add another 10 in Q2, but not on this initial order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 48 total now, 6 admins. And for timing, you had mentioned March 18 as the target. Is that still the date your ops team wants to be live?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, March 18. We’d like training the week before, ideally March 12 or 13. The main thing is we need the invoice dated after February 1 for budget reasons.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s fine. I’ll note billing start on March 18 and invoice issue date no earlier than February 1. Payment terms are net 30 per the draft, unless finance needs something else.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 works. Can you also make sure the PO number is on the invoice? It’ll be PO-4176. Our AP team will kick it back if that’s missing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, PO-4176 on the invoice. On pricing, the annual subscription is $38,400 for the 48 seats, and implementation is the one-time $4,500. No change from the quote I sent Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I have. Legal had one small request on the auto-renewal. They’re asking for 60 days’ notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, that’s usually acceptable. I’ll run it through deal desk and update the renewal notice language if approved. I don’t expect that to slow us down more than a day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If you can send the revised order form by tomorrow afternoon, I can route it for signature before month-end.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the updated order form and the implementation schedule, and I’ll copy your finance alias for the invoice instructions.
